I was initially going to ask my bf if he could pay for it but I mentioned it to my mum when I went around for a cup of tea and she was strongly expecting me to pay and told me it was my responsibility not my bf’s... even though he’s been in my life 3 years. In conclusion, building your sense of right and wrong through books, research, and trusted individuals can lead to informed and thoughtful decision-making.
